facts.two-in-snow: Two people walk through a snowstorm, hunched against the cold.
facts.crutches: One walks on crutches with a bandage on the head and a bell hanging from the neck.
facts.shawl-barefoot: The other, wrapped in a shawl with head bowed, walks barefoot.
facts.lit-window: On the wall behind is a lit stained-glass window with five pentacles painted on it.
facts.passing-by: The two walk past the front of the window.
facts.snow: Snowflakes swirl against a black background, and the ground is covered with snow.

glosses.lit-window: Help and warmth that are close, yet unseen.
glosses.crutches: A companion who walks together even when hurt.

reversedGloss.waning: The cold season passes, and recovery and help begin to show.
reversedGloss.internalized: Hiding the hardship and swallowing it alone.
reversedGloss.excess: The sense of lack grows, and everything feels short.

misdescriptions.wrong: They are going into the church.
